title: AC1021 physical SORTENTSTABLE selected-output qualification
scope: Qualify the exact physical AC1021 ModelSpace SORTENTSTABLE and owner dictionary as a bounded selected graph through ASCII/Binary DXF output and fresh typed/raw readback.

authority.dwgSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.93 SORTENTSTABLE
authority.formatRule: SORTENTSTABLE entries carry an entity handle and an independent sort handle; where an entity has no explicit mapping, its own handle supplies its ordering key. The table is associated with its block owner and the dictionary graph is a separate ownership/reference relationship.
authority.authorityLimit: The local ODA specification text is authoritative for the documented wire fields. This receipt does not claim native application ordering semantics beyond the checked output mapping.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing; author and producer are not independently authenticated. The source file and derivatives are not committed.

sourceProfile.membership: 1,266 unique ordered entity/sort-handle pairs target ModelSpace entities. The ModelSpace container contains 1,431 entities; 165 entities lack an explicit pair and use their own source handle as the sort key.

validation.result: PASS, exit 0 for ASCII and Binary DXF. Both paths verify the source table and dictionary identities, source-frame output qualification, all 1,431 ordered ModelSpace entity targets and sort keys, fresh typed/raw readback, refusal with destination preservation for an invalid source target, and successful retry on the same adapter after source restoration.
validation.ac1024Comparator: The focused AC1024 mechanical_example-imperial.dwg selector did not pass: it stopped at the existing owner-entity order/type readback assertion. This result is retained as an unresolved comparator and is not evidence that the AC1021 route supports AC1024.

limits: One unauthenticated physical source and one exact AC1021 ModelSpace graph only; no named-block SORTENTSTABLE profile is established.
Selected graph output does not establish whole-drawing conversion, native application semantics, producer-wide coverage, independent encoder interoperability, or support claims.
The AC1024 selected-output comparator remains unresolved.
